notes: Packet is the paper's own full text including appendix (arXiv 2510.01538v2). Role is borderline: the four-agent order is fixed and no loop re-plans, but validation metrics choose the retained models and ensemble strategy, so coded feedback_driven_agent. The fixed four-agent pipeline is treated as framework architecture, not a separate module. No LLM-side module: GPT-4o is off-the-shelf, the lightweight vision encoder is not described as trained, and prompts are in-context (R2 boundary). The 21-model library is baseline tooling, folded into the selection module. Reporter layer GH vs TSK is borderline. Report win rates (Table 2) judge report quality by pairwise comparison, not runtime execution, so process_validity is false.
